description: Finviz quote snapshot for one stock ticker: the key statistics table as label and value pairs (market cap, P/E, price, change, volume and similar), read from the public quote page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
